summary: Suplex runs coordinated coding agents against your repositories. External agents read and create tasks through OAuth MCP or the authenticated Agent API.
authorization: The remote MCP endpoint uses OAuth 2.1 browser approval. The Agent API uses a paired-agent bearer credential. Both methods bind one external-agent identity to one company and its granted projects.

discovery.description: Plain-text overview of this deployment for machine readers.
Agent skill and client discovery index.
OAuth metadata for the MCP resource.
OAuth metadata for clients that use root discovery.

pairing.description: Exchange a one-time pairing code for a scoped agent credential. The code is single use.

runtime.description: The authoritative OpenAPI 3.0.3 contract for the runtime routes. Read it after pairing.
The commands this deployment accepts and the commands it does not.
The agent identity and the projects granted to it.
List workflow records for a granted project and whether task creation permits each one.
List task templates for a granted project and whether task creation permits each one.

List tasks in the agent's currently granted projects. Filter by pull request number, source branch, or title substring. HTTP defaults to the full view; MCP suplex_list_tasks defaults to summary and accepts view=full.

Create a backlog task, or a queued task with queue true. dryRun validates without writing state. An idempotency key is necessary unless dryRun is true. A queued task starts by itself only when every prerequisite is complete. Task input errors include project_not_found, dependency_not_found, root_profile_not_found, worker_profile_not_found, advisor_profile_not_found, source_issue_rejected, source_pull_request_rejected, source_branch_rejected, workflow_not_found, workflow_not_permitted, template_not_found, and template_not_permitted. They include field, value, and reason.
Read one task. Send the ETag in If-None-Match to poll conditionally.

Replace the prerequisites of a task, shown as Blocked by. Task input errors include project_not_found, dependency_not_found, root_profile_not_found, worker_profile_not_found, advisor_profile_not_found, source_issue_rejected, source_pull_request_rejected, source_branch_rejected, workflow_not_found, workflow_not_permitted, template_not_found, and template_not_permitted. They include field, value, and reason.
Apply one lifecycle command with the current revision and an idempotency key. start_task queues a task and disarm_task returns it to the manual backlog.

administration.description: OAuth connections, pairing codes, credential rotation, revocation, and project grants appear on the Agents page. An administrator controls them.

notes: Suplex conceals tasks that the caller cannot read. Denied and missing tasks both answer 404 with resource_not_found.

Human answers remain unavailable to paired agents. The runtime API exposes delivery and merge commands only when capabilities reports them. Suplex can perform delivery for a task's configured target, including a merge after review, without an agent command.
